findings.reason: The cited alarms and alert confirm the sequence of power failure, battery low, and site down, supporting the inference.
ALM-000142 explicitly states a major MAINS_FAILURE on S-TUN-015 raised at 14:16.
ALM-000147 confirms the BATTERY_LOW alarm at 17:21, but the evidence does not state the cause was the mains failure.
The evidence shows the site down alarm at 17:36 and metric drops from 17:30, but the alert started 6 minutes before the site down alarm.
The evidence shows alarms cleared at 21:58, but does not explicitly confirm that full functionality was restored.
